ui.homeHero: Swedish iOS apps that solve everyday problems
ui.homeSubhero: Built for iPhone. No accounts, no tracking, no ad spam aimed at kids. Five apps that do one thing well.
ui.appsSubtitle: Small utilities. Local storage. Available on the App Store.
ui.aboutAuthor: Built solo by Alexander Bergqvist in Gothenburg, Sweden.

fodelsedagar.name: Birthdays
fodelsedagar.description: Birthdays is the iOS app that reminds you of the birthdays and anniversaries of the people who matter. Add photos, import from Contacts, and get notifications well in advance.
features: Reminders 1 month, 1 week, 1 day and same day

andas.name: Andas
andas.description: Andas is the iOS app for guided breathing. Wim Hof, box breathing 4-4-4-4 and 4-7-8 are free. Build your own protocols, track retention over time, and grow your practice.
features: Wim Hof Basic, box breathing and 4-7-8 (free)
Build your own protocols with sliders (Premium)

rita.name: Rita & Color
rita.tagline: A coloring app for kids ages 3 to 8.
rita.description: Rita is the iOS app where kids can color digital coloring pages. Safe — no login, no ads aimed at children, and a steady stream of new pages.
features: Dozens of coloring pages for different ages
Save your masterpieces inside the app

surdeg.name: Sourdough
surdeg.tagline: Feed, bake, enjoy — sourdough made simple.
surdeg.description: Sourdough is the iOS app for people who bake with a starter. Schedule feedings per starter, browse 33 Swedish and international recipes, and log your bakes in the bake journal.
features: Bake journal with photo, rating and notes

plantera.name: Plant Tracker
plantera.tagline: A garden tracker for Nordic climates.
plantera.description: Plant Tracker is the iOS app for people who garden in a Nordic climate. Get frost warnings, a sow + harvest calendar tuned to your zone, and curated tool tips.
features: Frost warnings based on local forecast
